title: Structure-Behavior Coalescence for Model-Based Systems Engineering
abstract: arXiv:2611.23255v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) has advanced system design and analysis for decades, yet traditional approaches often treat structure and behavior separately, resulting in inconsistencies, incomplete models, and ambiguity. This paper introduces Structure-Behavior Coalescence (SBC) as a formal and unified definition of systems for MBSE. SBC defines a system as a single integrated entity in which structure and behavior are coalesced through interaction, providing both a conceptual foundation and a formal process-algebra framework. Well-formedness constraints ensure that interactions are structurally grounded and compositions are valid, enabling consistency by construction. Boundary processes, including 0 for terminal states and a checkpoint construct for paused or suspended states, allow inactive and intermediate states to be represented while preserving system unity. Illustrative examples and a Smart Healthcare IoT case study demon

translated_title: 面向基于模型的系统工程的结构-行为融合
translated_abstract: 基于模型的系统工程数十年来推动了系统设计与分析的发展，但传统方法往往将结构与行为分开处理，导致不一致性、模型不完整和歧义。本文引入结构-行为融合作为 MBSE 中系统的形式化统一定义。SBC 将系统定义为单一集成实体，其中结构与行为通过交互而融合，既提供了概念基础，也提供了形式化的进程代数框架。良构性约束确保交互在结构上有据可依且组合有效，从而实现“构造即一致”。边界进程（包括用于终止状态的 0 进程，以及用于暂停或挂起状态的检查点构造）允许表示非活动和中间状态，同时保持系统的统一性。示例和智慧医疗物联网案例研究展示了该方法的有效性。
tldr: 本文提出结构-行为融合（SBC），将系统定义为结构与行为通过交互融合而成的单一集成实体，并借助进程代数框架与良构性约束实现MBSE中“构造即一致”的系统建模。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Structure-Behavior Coalescence (SBC), which defines a system as a single integrated entity where structure and behavior coalesce through interaction, providing a formal process-algebra framework with well-formedness constraints that achieve consistency by construction for MBSE.
